summary:
Implemented the rich_measure/VerticalCenter feature without running tests, per the instructions. Changes: rich/tree.py adds an iterative Tree.__rich_measure__ (explicit stack, level counter, 4 cells per indent level) and imports Measurement. rich/align.py adds VerticalCenter (render via render_lines with pad=False, padding as newline segments from console.size.height, measurement passthrough), Align.__repr__ and VerticalCenter.__repr__, and the Align width constraint (measured maximum, or min of maximum and explicit width). rich/console.py sets justify="default" in the render options for collected renderables in print; the justify argument still goes into _collect_renderables. CHANGELOG.md 9.8.0 is marked Unreleased with an Added subsection holding the two entries. tests/test_align.py gains a repr test, a VerticalCenter render test (checks joined segment text: "

foo


" at height 6), and a measurement test (3,3). tests/test_tree.py gains a measurement test expecting Measurement(11, 19). Nothing was committed. Tests have not been run, so pass/fail is unverified.
